title: SWE-Journey: Towards More Realistic Evaluation of Coding Assistants through Long-Horizon, Multi-Turn Interaction

body: Coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex have become a major application of LLM agents, yet existing benchmarks remain far from real-world use, particularly in task horizon and interaction length. Code assistants require completing long chains of development work in continuously evolving repositories, while repeatedly clarifying requirements and adapting implementations through multi-turn interaction. To address these gaps, we introduce SWE-Journey, a benchmark for more realistic evaluation of coding assistants. To address the task-horizon gap, we propose a weak-to-strong synthesis pipeline that automatically constructs long-horizon coding tasks. To address the interaction gap, we mine four representative user personas from real interaction data and build a user-simulation agent to reproduce realistic code-assistance interactions. On average, models pass over 75% of tests for requested functionality with software architects, but fewer than 25% with non-coders. These results show that current coding assistants still fall short of enabling reliable coding for non-coders. We further analyze the reasons for this gap and identify asking right, finding right, and fixing right as key capabilities during interaction.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了SWE-Journey基准，旨在更真实地评估代码助手类LLM代理，解决了现有基准在任务跨度和交互长度上的不足。为解决任务跨度问题，研究提出了一种弱到强合成流水线，自动构建长跨度编码任务。为解决交互长度问题，研究从真实交互数据中挖掘了四种代表性用户画像，并构建了用户模拟代理以复现真实的辅助编码交互。实验结果显示，模型在面对软件架构师时通过率超过75%，但在面对非程序员时低于25%，表明当前代码助手在服务非程序员方面仍有待提高。研究进一步分析了差距原因，并确定了“问对问题、找对信息、修对代码”是交互中的关键能力。
